Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BǪC A: Financial Criteria The bidder or its OEM shall have successfully supplied the same or similar category product, namely an ind ustrial machine / customized equipment for SC valve lock-nut removal or comparable industrial valve / co mponent assembly and disassembly, to any Central Government / State Government organization / PSU / Public Listed Company during at least one of the last three completed financial years preceding the bid op ening date.

The bidder shall have an operational manufacturing facility in India for the manufacture of mechanical syst ems of similar application, ensuring timely supply of the equipment. Alternatively, if the bidder is an author ized dealer or distributor, they shall submit a valid authorization certificate issued by the Original Equipme nt Manufacturer (OEM). For MSE vendors, there is relaxation in the BQC which will be as under: (As per Circular No.MA.TEC.POL.CO N.3A dated 26th Oct 2020. The bidder or its OEM (themselves or through reseller(s)) should have supplied same or similar category pr oduct(s) of value not less than ₹45,000/- in at least one of the last three completed financial years precedi ng the bid opening date to any Central / State Government organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Documentary evidence shall comprise Purchase Order / Work Order / LOA and Co mpletion Certificate / Final Bill / Payment Certificate or other conclusive evidence of satisfactory completio n. Any relaxation to eligible MSEs / Start-ups shall be applicable only as permitted by current BPCL procure ment guidelines and the bid conditions. Where the bidder is a dealer/distributor/reseller, the experience of the OEM may be considered subject to s ubmission of valid OEM authorization for the tender and documentary evidence establishing the OEM's cre dentials. Note: To ensure more participation which would lead to competitive rates, Limits have been fixed as above . All the documents required as per BQC A shall be certified as per the documents verification clause & an d submitted along with the price bid. BǪC B: Financial Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three completed financial yea rs (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) should be ₹45,000/- Documentary evidence in the form of certified aud ited Balance Sheets / Profit & Loss Accounts or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Account ant indicating turnover for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constituti on / incorporation of the bidder is less than three years, the average turnover for completed financial years after constitution shall be considered.BǪC C: Financial – Profitable Operation Criteria Net Worth of the Bidder / OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. “Net Worth” = “Equity + Reserves G Surplus” DEFINITION OF SIMILAR WORK Tenderer should submit experience of having successfully Industrial Pillar Drill Machine / Radial Drill Machi ne / Heavy Duty Drill Machine or other machines used in manufacturing plants/workshop. LPG bottling pla nts, refineries, petrochemical plants, engineering workshops, steel plants, or other industrial establishmen ts, during the last three years ending on the last day of the month before the month in which applications are invited. Similar supply means supply of industrial machines or customized equipment for valve / component lock-n ut removal or comparable assembly / disassembly applications to any Central / State Government organiz ation / PSU / Public Listed Company. The bidder / OEM shall demonstrate capability to manufacture and su pply the machine in accordance with BPCL's approved technical specification and drawings. Copies of all the certificates/drawings submitted, duly authenticated by the bidder, product catalogue, tech nical datasheet and quality assurance plan will be verified with the originals by BPCL. Also below technical documents required while submitting the bid .
